libraries.label: twinkleplop
libraries.note: full pipeline: grammar plus the language's reclassifier stack, as shipped.

libraries.label: Shiki (wasm)
libraries.note: Oniguruma wasm engine, shiki's default. HTML output carries inline styles rather than classes, which is strictly more string work than a class-based emitter does.

libraries.label: Shiki (JS engine)
libraries.note: same grammars, RegExp engine instead of wasm. Shiki's own benchmark treats these as separate arms; the wasm payload is a real deployment cost the JS engine avoids.

libraries.label: Prism
libraries.note: class-based HTML output, same as twinkleplop's.

libraries.label: sugar-high
libraries.note: JavaScript-shaped tokenizer with no grammar registry: it has no language argument, so it appears only in the JS-family charts. Coarser output than the others.
